notes: synthetic session: a flaky login e2e test fixed by waiting on a hydration marker; CI not yet run

rows.content: Not yet. The change is in the working tree only; CI has not run it. Next is to push a branch and watch 10 CI runs of the e2e job.
Good. Leave the CI retry setting alone, I want flakes to stay visible. Did you run it on CI?
Yes. The form sets data-hydrated on its root after hydration. I changed the test to wait for [data-hydrated] before clicking, in e2e/login.test.ts. 50 runs in a row pass locally.
Can we wait on something the app sets instead of a sleep?
3 of 30 runs fail, all with a timeout waiting for #submit to be clickable. The test clicks before the form hydrates: the button is in the server HTML but disabled until hydration.
The login e2e test fails about one run in ten on CI. Find out why and fix it without adding retries.

facts.title: Fix the flaky login e2e test
